pilgrimages.scope_note: Major Portuguese Marian pilgrimage destination with an archdiocesan pilgrimage from Braga Cathedral on the first Sunday of June and the shrine feast on 12 June.

pilgrimages.name: Visit and pilgrimage to the National Shrine of Saint Alphonsus Liguori
pilgrimages.scope_note: Historic national-shrine destination in Baltimore with current Traditional Latin Mass, public liturgy and arranged visits.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to the National Shrine of St. John Neumann
pilgrimages.scope_note: Open individual and organized group pilgrimage destination at the tomb of Saint John Neumann, with Rosary, Mass, museum and shrine visit.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to the Basilica Shrine of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal
pilgrimages.scope_note: Open Marian pilgrimage and retreat destination whose current devotional programme includes the historic Monday Perpetual Novena.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to the National Shrine of Our Lady of Czestochowa
pilgrimages.scope_note: Open Polish-American Marian pilgrimage destination in Doylestown.

pilgrimages.name: American Czestochowa Walking Pilgrimage
pilgrimages.scope_note: Long-running multi-day walking pilgrimage to Doylestown with groups from Great Meadows, Trenton and Philadelphia; current dates remain owned by the Shrine event programme.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to the National Shrine of Saint Elizabeth Ann Seton
pilgrimages.scope_note: Open national-shrine pilgrimage destination in Emmitsburg with historic homes, Basilica, prayer and tours.

pilgrimages.name: Annual Pilgrimage for the Sea Services
pilgrimages.scope_note: Annual pilgrimage and Mass gathering members of the U.S. Sea Services, families and the public at the Seton Shrine.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to the National Shrine Grotto of Our Lady of Lourdes
pilgrimages.scope_note: Marian pilgrimage destination in Emmitsburg with an annual novena of Masses culminating on the shrine's Our Lady of Lourdes feast day.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Notre-Dame de Bermont
pilgrimages.scope_note: Historic Marian pilgrimage destination near Domrémy, directly associated with Saint Joan of Arc’s documented devotional visits.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Notre-Dame des Marins at Arcachon
pilgrimages.scope_note: Maritime Marian sanctuary and minor basilica at Arcachon with a long local pilgrimage and sailors’ devotional identity.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Notre-Dame de Pontmain
pilgrimages.scope_note: Year-round pilgrimage destination at the site of the 1871 apparition.

pilgrimages.name: Pontmain Apparition Anniversary Pilgrimage
pilgrimages.scope_note: Annual 17 January pilgrimage observance marking the anniversary of the apparition at Pontmain.

pilgrimages.name: Pontmain Assumption Pilgrimage
pilgrimages.scope_note: Annual Assumption pilgrimage gathering at Pontmain with vigil, solemn Mass and Marian processions.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Notre-Dame de Pellevoisin
pilgrimages.scope_note: Year-round Marian pilgrimage destination at the apparition chapel of Pellevoisin.

pilgrimages.name: Grand Annual Pilgrimage to Pellevoisin
pilgrimages.scope_note: Grand annual pilgrimage on the last weekend of August, including procession, Rosary, scapular imposition and Mass.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Notre-Dame de Montligeon
pilgrimages.scope_note: Year-round pilgrimage destination dedicated to prayer for the dead and consolation of the bereaved.

pilgrimages.name: Pèlerinages du Ciel at Montligeon
pilgrimages.scope_note: Recurring November pilgrimage cycle for prayer for the dead; specific dates vary by year and remain owned by the shrine’s current programme.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to the Miraculous Medal Chapel, Rue du Bac
pilgrimages.scope_note: International Marian pilgrimage destination at the 1830 apparition chapel, with an established 27 November observance of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Maria vom Sieg Wigratzbad
pilgrimages.scope_note: Diocesan Marian pilgrimage destination with confession, Eucharistic adoration and recurring Sühnesamstag devotional observances.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Maria Hilf Amberg
pilgrimages.scope_note: Year-round pilgrimage destination on the Mariahilfberg in Amberg.

pilgrimages.name: Maria Hilf Bergfest Pilgrimage
pilgrimages.scope_note: Annual Bergfest pilgrimage cycle around the shrine's principal feast of the Visitation on 2 July, drawing foot pilgrims from the region.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to St. Leonhard Nußdorf
pilgrimages.scope_note: Historic saint pilgrimage church at Nußdorf with continuing local devotional customs.

pilgrimages.name: Nußdorf Leonhardiritt
pilgrimages.scope_note: Revived annual Leonhardiritt on 6 November with field Mass and blessing of horses.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to St. Apollinaris Frielingsdorf
pilgrimages.scope_note: Pilgrimage destination dedicated to Saint Apollinaris in Frielingsdorf.

pilgrimages.name: St. Apollinaris Octave at Frielingsdorf
pilgrimages.scope_note: Annual July octave at St. Apollinaris Frielingsdorf, centred on the 23 July feast.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to St. Salvator Bettbrunn
pilgrimages.scope_note: Historic Hostienwallfahrt and Salvator pilgrimage destination receiving numerous parish and pilgrimage groups each year.

pilgrimages.name: Preith Foot Pilgrimage to Bettbrunn
pilgrimages.scope_note: Two-day annual foot pilgrimage from Preith to Bettbrunn on the weekend after Ascension, documented as continuing since 1578.

pilgrimages.name: Bettbrunn Men's Pilgrimage
pilgrimages.scope_note: Major annual men's pilgrimage at Bettbrunn on the second Sunday of October.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Maria Vesperbild
pilgrimages.scope_note: Active Marian pilgrimage destination with Sunday pilgrim Mass and a Fatima pilgrimage day on the 13th of every month.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to St. Mary of the Assumption Shrine, Oswego
pilgrimages.scope_note: Traditional Latin Mass shrine destination served by the Institute of Christ the King Sovereign Priest.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Our Lady of Martyrs, Auriesville
pilgrimages.scope_note: Historic national pilgrimage destination associated with the North American Martyrs and St. Kateri Tekakwitha.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage for Restoration to Auriesville
pilgrimages.scope_note: Traditional three-day walking pilgrimage from Lake George to Auriesville, modeled on the Chartres pilgrimage and covering about 61 miles; annual dates are published year by year.

pilgrimages.name: Amsterdam to Auriesville Walking Eucharistic Pilgrimage
pilgrimages.scope_note: Annual walking Eucharistic pilgrimage from Amsterdam, New York, to the Auriesville shrine; the specific date is published annually.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to the National Shrine of The Divine Mercy
pilgrimages.scope_note: Year-round national pilgrimage destination with group and individual pilgrimage programmes, Stations, Confession, Adoration, Rosary, Chaplet and blessing of religious articles.

pilgrimages.name: Divine Mercy Sunday Pilgrimage at Stockbridge
pilgrimages.scope_note: The shrine's largest annual pilgrimage weekend, centred on the Sunday after Easter with Mass, Confession, Chaplet, Exposition, Benediction and blessing of religious articles.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Our Lady of La Salette, Attleboro
pilgrimages.scope_note: National Marian shrine destination rooted in the La Salette apparition and serving pilgrims in multiple languages, including a regular Sunday French Mass.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to Lourdes in Litchfield
pilgrimages.scope_note: Montfortian Marian pilgrimage destination with Lourdes grotto, Stations of the Cross and seasonal outdoor Masses.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to St. Anne Shrine, Fiskdale
pilgrimages.scope_note: New England pilgrimage destination dedicated to Saint Anne with devotional chapels, daily Rosary and a long-running annual novena.

pilgrimages.name: Annual St. Anne Novena at Fiskdale
pilgrimages.scope_note: Annual nine-day pilgrimage novena from 18 through 26 July, with nightly Rosary procession and Mass, culminating on the feast of Saints Anne and Joachim.

pilgrimages.name: Our Lady of Gietrzwałd — 8 September shrine celebration
pilgrimages.scope_note: 1877 Marian apparition shrine; annual Marian pilgrimage focused on the Nativity of Mary and locally observed 8 September ceremonies.

pilgrimages.name: Šilinės local pilgrimage opening 8 September
pilgrimages.scope_note: Lithuanian Catholic sanctuary and annual Šilinės pilgrimage; individual programme days vary from year to year.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage and Marian devotion at Cuapa
pilgrimages.scope_note: Site of reported 1980 Marian experiences, visited for prayer and pilgrimage; no single universal annual day asserted.

pilgrimages.name: Year-round pilgrimage to Finca Betania
pilgrimages.scope_note: Shrine associated with the 1976–1984 reported Marian events and diocesan recognition; no exact recurring programme presumed.

pilgrimages.name: 25 September Marian pilgrimage to San Nicolás
pilgrimages.scope_note: Official Argentine bishops' press coverage of the 25 September shrine feast and annual pilgrimages.

pilgrimages.name: Pilgrimage to the Basilica of the Holy Cross in Jerusalem (Rome)
pilgrimages.scope_note: Roman Seven Churches pilgrimage site and permanent relic collection. The Relics Chapel is temporarily closed for building works as announced April 2026; do not infer public access.
